overview.text: The RFP is for the execution of Development Works at Mahadeva Temple, Itagi, specifically the construction of Visitor Amenities and a Sculpture Shed for the fiscal year 2025-26. Issued by the Superintending Archaeologist, Archaeological Survey of India (ASI), Hampi Circle on behalf of the President of India, the tender invites previously shortlisted bidders to submit technical and financial bids.

issuing_organization: Superintending Archaeologist, Archaeological Survey of India (ASI), Hampi Circle

scope.text: The scope includes construction of visitor amenities and a sculpture shed at Mahadeva Temple, Itagi, involving earthwork, masonry, boundary wall fabrication, and structural steel work.
Estimated cost of the work is Rs. 78,14,000.00 with a Bid Security (EMD) amount of Rs. 1,96,000.00.
The work must be completed within 180 days, with completion by 30.03.2026.

key_requirements.text: Bidders must submit Form 3: Eligibility Declarations and Form 1: Bid Form to confirm conformity with qualification criteria.
Bid Security Declaration (Form 8) is mandatory; failure to provide it results in bid rejection as non-responsive.
Bidders must declare no conflict of interest and submit certified financial statements for the past three years.

eligibility.text: Participation is open only to bidders previously shortlisted as per eligibility and qualification criteria for this two-cover tender type.
Bidders must not be insolvent, bankrupt, blacklisted, or debarred by the Procuring Organisation within the last three years preceding bid submission.
Contractors are prohibited from sub-contracting the work or supply; they must maintain eligibility throughout contract execution.

important_dates.text: Tender documents can be downloaded starting 21.01.2026 @ 18:00 Hrs.
Technical Bid opening is scheduled for 11.02.2026 at 15.30 Hrs.
Bids must remain valid for a period not less than 90 days from the deadline for bid submission.

commercial_requirements.text: Services are billed on a Time & Material (T&M) basis; all payments shall be made in Indian Rupees only.
Performance Security is required at 5% of the work order amount payable immediately upon acceptance of the Tender.
Bid break-up must indicate GST rates and HSN codes separately; quoted prices include all relevant financial implications including taxes and transportation.

project_duration.text: Tendered work/Supply shall be completed within 180 days.

Time allowed for carrying out the work/Supply as entered in the tender of 180 days shall be reckoned from the 7 days after the date of issue of acceptance letter / the date of site handing over whichever is earlier.
Contractor shall commence the work within Seven (7) days of the date of acceptance of the work order or within Seven (7) days from the date of issue of work order whichever is earlier.

important_conditions.text: Confidentiality and non-disclosure obligations apply; all deliverables become the property of the Superintending Archaeologist.
The Integrity Pact must be duly signed; failure to do so results in disqualification and bid rejection.
Contractor must provide a comprehensive day-long training by a certified Third-Party agency for labour code awareness.
